column1: # Keyword prefix parity cases (issue #96). One case per line, tab-separated:
# The case deck is <deck> with the one occurrence of <find> replaced by <replace>
# (\n and \t escapes allowed). expect is either
#   same        the run gives the same .out bytes as <deck> itself, or
#   refuse:NNN  the run is refused and the report has ERROR NNN.
# Every expectation is checked against EPA SWMM 5.2.4 and OpenSWMM 5.3.0 by
# Section headers: legacy findmatch over SectWords, a header that begins with a
# YES/NO and OFF/ON flags: legacy findmatch over NoYesWords / OffOnWords; a
# word that begins with neither is ERROR 205.
# [OPTIONS] keys: legacy project_readOption findmatch over OptionWords.
# Node type words: OutfallTypeWords, RelationWords (storage) and
# DividerTypeWords, each read with findmatch; ERROR 205 when none matches.
# Link words: OrificeTypeWords, WeirTypeWords, RelationWords (outlets, with a
# whole-word HEAD qualifier) and TransectKeyWords, read with findmatch.
# Hydrology and climate: RainTypeWords, GageDataWords, EvapTypeWords (DRY_ONLY
# YES/NO compared as whole words), TempKeyWords (WINDSPEED FILE compared as a
# whole word), ADC IMPERVIOUS/PERVIOUS, SnowmeltWords, LidTypeWords,
# LidLayerWords, [GWF] LAT/DEEP and [ADJUSTMENTS] (already read by prefix).
# Tables and inflows: CurveTypeWords, PatternTypeWords, [INFLOWS] FLOW,
# CONCEN and MASS (match()), [DWF] FLOW, [HYDROGRAPHS] ALL (match()) and
# process variables (ProcessVarWords, findmatch after this engine's exact
# Streets and inlets: InletTypeWords, GrateTypeWords, ThroatAngleWords and
# PlacementTypeWords, read with findmatch (an exact word first: legacy's list
# order reads P_BAR-50x100 as P_BAR-50). No unknown-placement case: legacy's
# PlacementTypeWords has no NULL terminator, so findmatch on a word it does
# not know reads past the list.
# EXPRESSION naming a variable not defined above it is ERROR 233.
# [REPORT]: ReportWords and NoYesWords (findmatch); an unknown key or flag word
# is ERROR 205. (An undefined name is WARNING 109 in this engine by design,
# where legacy gives ERROR 209, so LINKS ALLZ has no case here.)
